description: This file defines the PatchedConnectorConfig interface and related functions for JSON serialization/deserialization, representing configuration data for connectors in the Tandoor API project.

classes.name: PatchedConnectorConfig
classes.description: Interface representing a patched connector configuration with optional properties for connector settings.

methods.name: instanceOfPatchedConnectorConfig
methods.description: Type guard function to check if an object implements PatchedConnectorConfig.

methods.name: PatchedConnectorConfigFromJSON
methods.description: Creates a PatchedConnectorConfig object from a JSON object.

methods.name: PatchedConnectorConfigFromJSONTyped
methods.description: Creates a PatchedConnectorConfig object from a JSON object with optional discriminator handling.

methods.name: PatchedConnectorConfigToJSON
methods.description: Serializes a PatchedConnectorConfig object to JSON.
